# shadow/no-physical-direction-classes

Prefer logical classes for LTR and RTL layouts.

`fixable` `has suggestions`

## Why

Logical classes mirror with reading direction; physical edges do not.

## Incorrect

```tsx
<div class="ml-2 pl-4 text-left" />
```

## Correct

```tsx
<div class="ms-2 ps-4 text-start" />
```

```tsx
<div class="rtl:ml-2 ltr:mr-2" />
```

## Options

```json
[
  {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "fix": {
        "type": "boolean"
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
]
```

## Autofix and suggestions

Offers suggestions; { fix: true } enables autofix. Encoded literals have no fix.

## Disabling

Disable one line with `// eslint-disable-next-line shadow/no-physical-direction-classes`, a block with `/* eslint-disable shadow/no-physical-direction-classes */` and `/* eslint-enable shadow/no-physical-direction-classes */`, or a whole file with the block form at its top. Disable for intentional physical edges that do not mirror in RTL.

## Notes

- Static literals only. Allows rtl/ltr/data-[side=...] variants. Limit: 10,000 nodes.

## Messages

- `physical`: Use logical direction classes: {{classes}}.
- `logical`: Use logical direction classes.
- `limit`: Class expression exceeds 10,000 nodes. Split it into smaller components.
